findings.source: morphology_policy/strategy.py, strategy.drm; v6-native-runtime.ts factory and group assembly
findings.finding: One branch_routing owner is registered at parallel_branch_routing, immediately after motif_conditioned_access and before conserved_band_transfer. The aligned entryPoints slot is null. The wrapper preserves material_access_subquestion without inventing a shared-subquestion evaluator.

Successful selected acquisitions retain the single source event at branches:<before.revision>, with after.observation_ref and after.revision. BranchRouting has no added passive record path or second business-state owner. family_state:branch_routing remains the separate native checkpoint.

The wrapper owns a detached frozen input snapshot and forwards current execution. An incomplete current proposal gains block_unrelated_probe:true; a completed source null remains a completed abstention. The refusal stays bound to the observation and owner state.

Only BranchRoutingIncomplete is converted into events:[] and native_acquisition_incomplete. The refusal binds the actual after observation and has status:unknown, release_authority:false and frontier.complete:false. Other errors are not disguised as computation limits. acquisitionExecution reaches BranchRouting without changing historical argument lists for unrelated owners.

A BranchRouting incomplete receipt carries acquired:false, release_authority:false, proposal_ref and a detached complete WitnessedTransition, including before/after measurements, first/second public packets, command, index and outcome. It is retained in the authoritative prefix evidence, not only in the bounded trace.

The first incomplete selected return creates a per-prefix barrier. Subsequent BranchRouting returns receive earlier_selected_acquisition_incomplete receipts with source_record_attempted:false and are not passed to the owner. Each actual public return is retained. Other common/passive owners keep their single acquisition pass.

The integration closes the prefix and stops with native_acquisition_incomplete, subject to the existing precedence of official completion. resume does not restart a stopped run. No automatic reacquisition, physical redispatch or replay of already acquired passive owners is promised.

An ordinary increased-score return remains prior to identity enumeration, events and finished. passed/events retain the source diagnostic meanings; finished alone is not a level victory. If an earlier incomplete return already suspends the owner, later official returns still require explicit non-acquired receipts.

callerIntegrationReview.counterQualification: acquiredRecords and caller.acquiredTransitions are common callback/reconciliation counters, including incomplete markers. They are not by themselves the number of successful BranchRouting source acquisitions; source events and non-acquired receipts provide that distinction.

publicDomainReview.assumption: Nonempty measured public rasters with W*H <= 65536, rectangular connected components supplied by the public observer, and ordinary source proposal/guard/acquisition flow. Arbitrary fabricated observation entities or arbitrary calls to record are not authenticated by restore.
publicDomainReview.method: Deduction from pinned source control flow and measured-component constraints, plus read-only review of seven test definitions; no numerical enumeration or component execution.

findings.finding: The original source loop appends each measured unit-square source at most once because it breaks after a matching cap. These measured components are distinct even when their tangent ranks coincide. sources.length*unit^2 <= 65536 is therefore necessary, and repeated sorted ranks remain permitted.

unit*limit equals unit*floor(initial tangent extent/unit), no greater than the actual initial extent. Aligned bars and cavities have unit-multiple origins and lengths, so their full tangent bounds fit within this truncated extent. Combining it with retained normal positions gives a necessary initial public surface condition.

Initial bars are distinct full rectangular measured components. Their aggregate area and count must fit the surface budget. Quotient checks precede the relevant geometry products, avoiding unsafe large intermediate products.

current is validated as complete measured boxes in its own possible public rectangle, independently of the initial model rectangle. A public width/height change within an epoch is not rejected solely because it differs from the original layout shape.

seen and event.before validate nonnegative origins rather than requiring complete predicted boxes. This preserves original read_state acceptance of a uniform nonempty partial slice. Future predictions that never pass a before guard are not acquired states.

Each historical before/after state is checked independently. Historical bar counts, orientation and unit are not compared with the new model. Acquired axial motion may be non-unit and survives model-free or differently shaped epochs.

The pure read_state helper keeps Python negative-slice semantics. Nonnegative retained origins are consistent with source-generated guarded trajectories, which start from measured nonnegative poses and move toward nonnegative placement targets. The broader pure-helper domain is not treated as arbitrary acquired-state provenance.

publicDomainReview.testQualification: The new tests explicitly use generic counterfactual checkpoints for necessary public numeric constraints. They do not claim that restore authenticates an originally acquired policy.
residualLimits: The conditions are necessary, not a full realization or provenance proof. Some checkpoints satisfying them can still describe arrangements that no original layout observation produced.
Per-state surface constraints do not impose a total quota on cumulative events, seen entries, references, action keys or their validation/copy cost.
The snapshot does not retain historical models/frame dimensions; historical validation deliberately uses independent necessary origin-domain bounds rather than reconstructing missing provenance.

preservedLimits: This read-only review and the parent's synthetic functional receipts do not establish complete original common-caller or strategic selection parity.
The retained original component corpus distinguishes cold acquisition, exact retained acquisition and declared counterfactual motion seeds; those provenance categories remain unchanged.
The restoration validator checks necessary public representability, shape and coherence; it does not authenticate physical acquisition provenance.
Cumulative history size, copying, layout work and overall latency are not globally bounded by the two enumeration ceilings or by per-state public surface checks.
Incomplete selected acquisitions end in a terminal stop with complete non-acquired public witnesses. No automatic retry or resumable exactly-once acquisition protocol is claimed.
Official completion and common callback counts must not be reported as successful BranchRouting acquisition of returns marked acquired:false.
Connection coverage, static source inventory, broader regression results, official performance acceptance and publication require their own receipts.
No game payload, LKEY execution, reset, replay or oracle was introduced or interpreted by these reviews.
